title: 港股午评：恒指涨1.86% 科指涨2.69% 科网股、汽车股普涨 创新药概念大涨
summary: 港股7月10日午盘：恒生指数涨1.86%，恒生科技指数涨2.69%，科网股、新能源汽车股及创新药概念均大幅上涨，昨日跌幅已完全修复。
why: 港股今日大涨，创新药与汽车股领涨，有利于持有腾讯、美团、小米等相关标的；高波动率环境或提升期权权利金收益。

title: 2026版国家基本药物目录出炉 794种药品涵盖16款创新药，9月1日起实施
summary: 2026版国家基本药物目录时隔8年重磅更新，总品种扩容至794种，首次批量纳入16款创新药（含4款国产一类新药），于9月1日起正式实施。
why: 创新药首次批量纳入基药目录，将大幅提升医院准入覆盖范围，港股创新药板块重大政策催化剂，关注药明生物、信达生物等标的。

title: Fed minutes June 2026: 9 officials favor rate hike by year-end; Warsh drops forward guidance
summary: June FOMC minutes reveal a 9-to-8 split on whether to hike rates by year-end. New Fed Chair Warsh eliminated forward guidance in favor of data dependence. Rates held at 3.5-3.75% for fourth straight meeting. CPI rose 4.2% YoY in May — highest since April 2023.
why: 美联储内部鹰鸽分歧加剧，年内加息预期升温；利率上行压力将压制港股/美股高估值科技股，需关注持仓的sell put执行价设置与期权IV变化。

title: US strikes over 80 Iran targets, revokes oil sanctions waiver after Hormuz tanker attacks
summary: US military struck 80+ Iranian targets (air defense, IRGC boats, coastal radar) after Iran attacked 3 commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. US revoked the 60-day oil sanctions waiver; Iran claimed it struck 85 US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait in response.
why: 霍尔木兹地缘危机骤升，油价上涨压力加大；全球risk-off情绪对港股/A股高估值板块构成压力，期权隐含波动率或跳升，适合策略性收窄净仓暴露。

title: 工业富联H1净利预增93%-101%至234-244亿元，AI服务器需求持续爆发
summary: 工业富联（601138.SH）发布2026年上半年业绩预增公告，预计归母净利润234亿元至244亿元，同比增长93%至101%，超市场预期，受益于AI服务器需求强劲。
why: A股AI服务器龙头业绩大超预期，验证AI基础设施投资持续爆发；对英伟达等上游供应商同步形成利好佐证，是板块情绪重要催化剂。

title: Apple ramps foldable iPhone Ultra production to 10M units for September launch
summary: Apple has told suppliers to prepare 10M foldable iPhone Ultra units for H2 2026 (up from prior 7-8M forecast). Device features 7.8-inch inner display, A20 chip, priced at ~$2,300-$2,500. Production confirmed on track, September launch expected.
why: 苹果折叠屏突破将重塑消费电子格局，利好A股/港股苹果供应链（立讯精密等）；竞争压力亦影响小米等安卓折叠屏阵营估值。

title: Alibaba pays $600M to settle DOJ probe over illegal drug sales; BABA stock surges to $108
summary: Alibaba and AUS Merchant Services (Ant Group unit) agreed to $600M non-prosecution settlement with DOJ over illegal pharmaceutical/controlled substance sales on Alibaba.com and AliExpress (2016-2024). No criminal admission. Stock surged from ~$96 to $108 on news. Daiwa/Nomura cut targets to $175/$178 but maintained Buy.
why: 最大法律悬案解除，BABA股价已反弹约13%；阿里AI转型（通义千问/阿里云）叙事重燃，DOJ和解移除重大折价因子，利好9988.HK和BABA中长期持仓。

title: Xiaomi unveils Sky Nomad EREV brand; June deliveries +36% YoY to 34,738 units
summary: Xiaomi launched Sky Nomad (澎程) as a dedicated extended-range EV brand targeting large SUVs, competing with Li Auto and Aito M9. Flagship N90 SUV offers 1,500km range, 5.3m length, 70+ kWh battery. June deliveries rose 36.4% YoY to 34,738 units. Full-year 2026 target: 550,000 units.
why: 小米汽车品牌扩张+6月交付强劲反弹，直接竞争增程市场龙头理想汽车；全年55万辆目标支撑1810.HK中长期增长，期权sell put可关注回调中的支撑位。

title: 德银对泡泡玛特发卖出警告：Labubu疲软+海外降温，预测全年营收或负增长
summary: 德意志银行预测泡泡玛特Q2增速大幅放缓，维持卖出评级；预测全年营收364亿元（低于市场一致预期456亿元约20%），净利116亿元（低于预期24%）。Labubu二级市场溢价已消退，与三丽鸥联名款较零售价折价40%。8月25日业绩披露为关键时点。
why: 9992.HK面临严重估值下修风险，德银预测全年可能负增长；如持有相关仓位，8/25业绩前后波动率将升高，需评估covered call保护策略。
source: 德意志银行/界面财联社

title: Tencent backs DeepSeek $7B round at $50B+ valuation; BAT trio jointly invest $2.8B in Kling AI
summary: Tencent to invest $1.5B in DeepSeek's inaugural $7B funding round (valued at $50B+). Separately, Alibaba, Tencent, and Baidu (BAT) jointly invested in Kuaishou's Kling AI ($2.8B round, $15B pre-money valuation). BAT's rare co-investment signals urgency to counter ByteDance dominance in generative video.
why: 腾讯通过DeepSeek+Kling AI双线布局中国AI生态，加速AI估值重估；与阿里/百度罕见联合出资体现协同对抗字节节奏加快，利好0700.HK中长期叙事。

title: 富途控股遭证监会拟罚18.5亿元，美国集体诉讼截止日8月25日
summary: 富途控股(FUTU)收到中国证监会调查通知及行政处罚预先告知书，拟罚款合计约18.5亿元人民币（约$2.71亿），原因是相关实体在内地无牌经营证券/公募/期货业务。CEO另被拟个人处罚125万元。美国多家律所集体诉讼截止日为2026年8月25日，股价已于5月22日单日暴跌27.5%。
why: FUTU监管风险持续升温，罚款+诉讼不确定性叠加；如持有FUTU仓位，建议警惕8月25日前后的波动，期权sell put策略需暂缓或提高执行价安全边际。

title: EU court confirms €4.1B Alphabet antitrust fine with no further appeal; DOJ still pursues Chrome divestiture
summary: The EU Court of Justice dismissed Alphabet's final appeal on July 2, 2026, definitively confirming the €4.1B Android antitrust fine. No further appeal options remain. The DOJ separately cross-appealed the remedies ruling and continues pursuing Chrome divestiture; circuit court expected to hear arguments in late 2026.
why: 谷歌欧盟罚款盖棺定论，同时DOJ Chrome拆分悬案仍在进行；多重监管压力叠加$180-190亿年度资本开支，GOOGL风险回报需重评，短期期权IV偏高。
source: 多家媒体综合（EU ruling July 2）

title: Tesla Q2: 480K deliveries (+25% YoY, beats consensus by 74K); robotaxi expands to Miami; earnings July 22
summary: Tesla Q2 2026 delivered 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY), significantly beating Wall St. consensus of ~406K. Produced 450K+ vehicles and deployed 13.5 GWh energy storage. Launched driverless robotaxi service in Miami — 3rd state alongside TX and CA. Official Q2 financial results due July 22.
why: 特斯拉Q2交付大超预期，短期催化已部分兑现；7月22日财报将验证利润质量，机器人出租车商业化扩张是中长期期权策略重要观察指标。

title: Circle (CRCL) crashes 17% as Visa/MC/Stripe launch OUSD stablecoin coalition threatening USDC
summary: Circle (CRCL) shares fell 17.55% to $63.85 after Open USD (OUSD) — a stablecoin backed by 140+ corporate partners including Visa, Mastercard, and Stripe — launched to compete with USDC. Circle derives 96% of revenue from USDC reserve interest; OUSD offers higher yield share-back, directly threatening Circle's model.
why: Circle商业模式核心受Visa/MC分发优势的竞争对手威胁，稳定币赛道竞争格局剧变；CRCL持仓面临进一步下行风险，加密生态格局可能重构。
